verdict.rationale: Claude Code's core interface is natural-language driven — docs show users describing tasks in plain language and Claude planning, coding, testing, git operations, and tool integrations (Slack, Jira, GitHub) all from NL prompts. Community evidence confirms real-world use as an agentic coding assistant, though some users report inconsistent execution quality, which is a reliability caveat rather than a contradiction of the NL-command capability itself.
